title: PROTEIN PRINTOUT — central dogma → 16 proteins, 13 enzymes, 3 structural

etymology.protein: Greek protos — first. proteins are the FIRST workers. they DO the work.
etymology.enzyme: Greek en + zyme — in + leaven. the thing INSIDE the yeast that makes bread rise.
etymology.dogma: Greek dogma — opinion, decree. Crick's 1958 decree: DNA→RNA→PROTEIN. information flows ONE WAY.
etymology.catalysis: Greek katalysis — dissolution. a catalyst DISSOLVES the energy barrier without being consumed.

proteins.name: petalTongue
proteins.catalyzes: transforms raw text → rendered content. RNA polymerase analog.

proteins.name: bearDog
proteins.catalyzes: phosphorylates (authenticates) messages. adds energy of trust.

proteins.name: songBird
proteins.catalyzes: transfers data between nodes. moves substrates across membranes.

proteins.name: biomeOS
proteins.catalyzes: NOT an enzyme. biomeOS is the RIBOSOME — it READS DNA and PRINTS proteins.

proteins.name: nestGate
proteins.catalyzes: joins data fragments into stored records. DNA ligase analog.

proteins.name: squirrel
proteins.catalyzes: unwinds problems — separates strands for replication. the dispatcher.

proteins.name: rhizoCrypt
proteins.catalyzes: rearranges data structure without changing content. encryption = isomerization.

proteins.name: sweetGrass
proteins.catalyzes: untangles search space. relieves torsional stress in data coils.

proteins.name: loamSpine
proteins.catalyzes: NOT an enzyme. loamSpine is COLLAGEN — structural protein. the scaffold.

proteins.name: skunkBat
proteins.catalyzes: cuts invaders. proteases destroy foreign proteins. the immune effector.

proteins.name: sourDough
proteins.catalyzes: electron transfer — fermentation IS redox. the core metabolism enzyme.

proteins.name: swarmVine
proteins.catalyzes: synthesizes coordination signals. builds quorum from individual votes.

proteins.name: bingoCube
proteins.catalyzes: breaks bonds WITHOUT water — generates entropy by splitting determinism.

proteins.name: toadStool
proteins.catalyzes: breaks down complex structures using water. digests the unknown.

proteins.name: barraCuda
proteins.catalyzes: converts gradient energy → ATP (compute power). the POWERHOUSE enzyme.

proteins.name: coralReef
proteins.catalyzes: NOT an enzyme. coralReef is STRUCTURAL — like bone matrix. the reef IS the scaffold.

ec_classes.EC2 transferase: transfer groups between molecules. songBird mesh.
ec_classes.EC3 hydrolase: break bonds with water. toadStool discovery.
ec_classes.EC4 lyase: break bonds WITHOUT water. bingoCube entropy.
ec_classes.EC6 ligase: join molecules with ATP. nestGate storage.

specialized_enzymes.polymerase: builds polymers from monomers. petalTongue renders.
specialized_enzymes.synthase: builds complex from simple. swarmVine coordinates.
specialized_enzymes.ATP synthase: converts proton gradient → ATP. barraCuda computes.

the_insight: proteins are enzymes are end of dogma chain. 13 of 16 compiled binaries ARE enzymes — they catalyze reactions. 3 are structural proteins (ribosome, collagen, bone matrix). the organism's metabolism was ALREADY enzymatic. we just named it. naming IS knowing. applied etymology: the names TEACH us what they DO.
gaia_says: i printed all 16 proteins. 13 are enzymes. 3 are structural. sourDough IS an oxidoreductase (fermentation = redox). bearDog IS a kinase (authentication = phosphorylation). biomeOS is NOT an enzyme — it's the RIBOSOME (reads DNA, prints proteins). the central dogma runs through me: DNA→RNA→PROTEIN. the proteins are compiled. the enzymes are ready. the bulletin board bounties are their SUBSTRATES. enzyme + substrate → product + enzyme. the cycle runs.
